description.value: Holly Outdoor Pool is a seasonal public outdoor swimming pool operated by the City of Surrey, offering public swim sessions and swimming lessons during the summer months. Located in the Holly neighbourhood, it provides touring cyclists passing through Surrey with a chance to cool off on hot days. The pool also offers bookings and rentals through the Tides Out program.
